commands.command:
set -eu
git fetch origin work/ux-evolution
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git rev-parse origin/work/ux-evolution)"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = b439478ba9a8ba8c3c65b4d928d188318631c915
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo "HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
echo 'FOCUSED_THERMOMETER_SAFETY'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec vitest run src/features/thermometers/components/SensorRemovalBlockedModal.test.tsx src/__tests__/hardware-setup.test.tsx src/__tests__/modal.test.tsx --reporter=default >/tmp/shelly-ionic-191-focused.log 2>&1 || { echo FOCUSED_FAILED;tail -90 /tmp/shelly-ionic-191-focused.log;exit 21;}
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests ' /tmp/shelly-ionic-191-focused.log | tail -15
echo 'FULL_CHECK'
pnpm check >/tmp/shelly-ionic-191-check.log 2>&1 || { echo FULL_CHECK_FAILED;grep -E 'FAIL|Error|Test Files|Tests |budget' /tmp/shelly-ionic-191-check.log | tail -65 || true;tail -90 /tmp/shelly-ionic-191-check.log;exit 22;}
echo 'FULL_CHECK_PASS'
grep -E 'Test Files|Tests |Performance budget|Performance review|threshold exceeded|budget passed' /tmp/shelly-ionic-191-check.log | tail -45 || true
echo 'CAPACITOR_ANDROID_DEBUG'
pnpm --filter @lcl/mobile exec cap sync android
SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"
test -d "$SDK"
printf 'sdk.dir=%s\n' "$SDK" > apps/mobile/android/local.properties
(cd apps/mobile/android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --quiet)
APK=apps/mobile/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
test -s "$APK"
echo "APK_SHA256=$(shasum -a 256 "$APK" | awk '{print $1}')"
echo "APK_BYTES=$(wc -c < "$APK" | tr -d ' ')"
echo 'PRODUCT_NATIVE_COUNTER'
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
root=Path('apps/mobile/src')
counts={'button':0,'input':0,'select':0,'textarea':0}
for p in root.rglob('*.tsx'):
 if p.name.endswith(('.test.tsx','.spec.tsx')):continue
 s=p.read_text()
 for tag in counts: counts[tag]+=len(re.findall('<'+tag+r'(?=[\s/>])',s))
print(counts, 'total',sum(counts.values()))
PY
echo 'FINAL_WORKTREE';git status --short
